item.title: Lisa McGowan wins Entrepreneur of the year! - Make-A-Wish Ireland - Children's Charity
item.description: Lisa McGowan, one of our amazing fundraisers here at Make-A-Wish Ireland, won the entrepreneur of the year award at this years gossies.

item.title: Wish Week 2025 - Make-A-Wish Ireland - Children's Charity
item.description: Wish Week 2025 is our annual fundraising campaign where we raise awareness of the vital work we do come together to make wishes come true!

item.title: its4women sponsor Wish Week - Make-A-Wish Ireland - Children's Charity
item.description: We are delighted to welcome its4women as an official partner of Make-A-Wish Ireland for 2025, kicking off their partnership by sponsoring Wish Week.

item.title: Announcing our Bord Bia Bloom Garden of Hope - Make-A-Wish Ireland - Children's Charity
item.description: We are delighted to Unveil Make-A-Wish Ireland's “Garden of Hope” at Bord Bia Bloom 2025, created to shine a light on critically ill children across Ireland.

item.title: The Paddy Cole Memorial Golf Classic - Make-A-Wish Ireland - Children's Charity
item.description: On Wednesday, May 28th we held the Paddy Cole Memorial Golf Classic at Powerscourt Golf Course, in honour of our Ambassador Paddy Cole.

item.title: The VHI Women's Mini Marathon - Make-A-Wish Ireland - Children's Charity
item.description: This June, more than 15 incredible women took to the streets of Dublin for the VHI Women’s Mini Marathon in aid of Make-A-Wish Ireland.

item.title: Make-A-Wish Woodland - Make-A-Wish Ireland - Children's Charity
item.description: Following on from the development of our sustainability charter, we developed the Make-A-Wish Woodland, in partnership with VEON.

item.title: 11:11 - Make-A-Wish Ireland - Children's Charity
item.description: We're turning the nation’s broken clocks into symbols of hope, frozen at 11:11, the magical minute when people pause to make a wish.
